scope.name: EXPOSED_R7C_REMAINDER_DISCOVERY_ONLY
scope.target_definition: Exactly the R7C target cases whose frozen R7C candidate remains OPEN.

frozen_width.meaning: Only clauses/resolvents of width <= 4 may carry candidate proof authority.

candidate_mechanisms: R7C deterministic convergence and polynomial closure
proof-carrying empty-clause refutation if bounded-width resolution derives contradiction
exact Davis-Putnam variable elimination only for a pivot whose every non-tautological resolvent has width <= 4
deterministic reverse elimination witness reconstruction if all variables are eliminated
candidate_forbidden: Davis-Putnam elimination when any required resolvent exceeds width 4

terminal_law.UNSAT: Only if an empty clause is derived by a replayable width<=4 resolution proof or exact bounded-width elimination.
terminal_law.SAT: Only if bounded-width exact elimination removes every variable and reverse reconstruction yields a replayable model of the original CNF.
terminal_law.OPEN: If the proof path needs width>4, no safe pivot remains, proof reconstruction fails, or any unsupported state is encountered.

complexity_claim_ceiling: For frozen constant k=4, the universe of candidate clauses of width <=k is polynomial in n; all candidate loops must range only over explicit polynomial-size clause/pivot structures. This R7D run is discovery evidence on ten exposed kernels, not a proof for arbitrary CNF.
success_interpretation: Any recovered terminal is evidence that meet-then-diverge plus fixed-width proof machinery can close part of the exposed dense-3SAT remainder without exhaustive search. Even 10/10 recovery would not establish arbitrary-CNF totality, general speedup, or P=NP.
